leadText:
Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition is a Region 4 DVD released by in Australia on November 1, 2017 and in New Zealand on November 15, 2017. It contains a total of 112 discs with a total runtime of approximately 341 hours from the Slimpack releases of the first 19 seasons of . Its catalogue number is BHE7754.

The DVDs included in this set are encoded in the color-coding system, and are region-locked to . It utilises , and aspect ratios.
